Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Definitions.

Require Import Stareat.

Require Import Misc.

Reserved Notation "[ L ] G1 ⊢k S <⦂ U k⊣ G2" (at level 70).

Inductive subtysk : vars -> env -> typ -> typ -> env -> Prop :=

| ssk_refl : forall L G1 G2 x,
    [ L ] G1 ⊢k typ_sel x <⦂ typ_sel x k⊣ G2

| ssk_top : forall L G1 G2 T,
    [ L ] G1 ⊢k T <⦂ typ_top k⊣ G2

| ssk_bot : forall L G1 G2 T,
    [ L ] G1 ⊢k typ_bot <⦂ T k⊣ G2

| ssk_bnd : forall L G1 G2 S T1 T2 U,
    [ L ] G2 ⊢k S <⦂ T1 k⊣ G1 ->
    [ L ] G1 ⊢k T2 <⦂ U k⊣ G2 ->
    [ L ] G1 ⊢k typ_bnd T1 T2 <⦂ typ_bnd S U k⊣ G2

| ssk_all : forall L G1 G2 T1 T2 U1 U2 x,
    x `notin` fv G1 `union` fv T1 `union` fv T2
      `union` fv U1 `union` fv U2 `union` fv G2 `union` L ->
    [ L ] G2 ⊢k T2 <⦂ T1 k⊣ G1 ->
    [ union L (union (singleton x) (fv T2)) ]
      x ~ T1 ++ G1 ⊢k open x U1 <⦂ open x U2 k⊣ x ~ T2 ++ G2 ->
    [ L ] G1 ⊢k typ_all T1 U1 <⦂ typ_all T2 U2 k⊣ G2

| ssk_sel1 : forall L G1 G2 x T S,
    binds x T G2 ->
    [ L ] G2 ⊢k T <⦂ typ_bnd S typ_top k⊣ G1 ->
    [ L ] G1 ⊢k S <⦂ typ_sel $ avar_f x k⊣ G2

| ssk_sel2 : forall L G1 G2 x T U,
    binds x T G1 ->
    [ L ] G1 ⊢k T <⦂ typ_bnd typ_bot U k⊣ G2 ->
    [ L ] G1 ⊢k typ_sel $ avar_f x <⦂ U k⊣ G2
where "[ L ] G1 ⊢k S <⦂ U k⊣ G2" := (subtysk L G1 S U G2).

Reserved Notation "[ L ] G1 >> T '<⦂p' U << G2" (at level 70).

Inductive subtysk' : vars -> env -> typ -> typ -> env -> nat -> Prop :=
| ssk'_refl : forall L G1 G2 x, subtysk' L G1 (typ_sel x) (typ_sel x) G2 1
| ssk'_top : forall L G1 G2 T, subtysk' L G1 T typ_top G2 1
| ssk'_bot : forall L G1 G2 T, subtysk' L G1 typ_bot T G2 1
| ssk'_bnd : forall L G1 G2 S T1 T2 U n1 n2,
    subtysk' L G2 S T1 G1 n1 -> subtysk' L G1 T2 U G2 n2 ->
    subtysk' L G1 (typ_bnd T1 T2) (typ_bnd S U) G2 (1 + n1 + n2)
| ssk'_all : forall L G1 G2 T1 T2 U1 U2 x n1 n2,
    x `notin` fv G1 `union` fv T1 `union` fv T2
      `union` fv U1 `union` fv U2 `union` fv G2 `union` L ->
    subtysk' L G2 T2 T1 G1 n1 ->
    subtysk' (union L (union (singleton x) (fv T2)))
            (x ~ T1 ++ G1) (open x U1) (open x U2) (x ~ T2 ++ G2) n2 ->
    subtysk' L G1 (typ_all T1 U1) (typ_all T2 U2) G2 (1 + n1 + n2)
| ssk'_sel1 : forall L G1 G2 x T S n,
    binds x T G2 ->
    subtysk' L G2 T (typ_bnd S typ_top) G1 n ->
    subtysk' L G1 S (typ_sel $ avar_f x) G2 (1 + n)
| ssk'_sel2 : forall L G1 G2 x T U n,
    binds x T G1 ->
    subtysk' L G1 T (typ_bnd typ_bot U) G2 n ->
    subtysk' L G1 (typ_sel $ avar_f x) U G2 (1 + n).

Theorem subtysk_equiv_stareat : forall L G1 S U G2,
    wf_env G1 -> wf_env G2 ->
    fv S [<=] dom G1 -> lc S ->
    fv U [<=] dom G2 -> lc U ->
    [ L `union` fv G1 `union` fv G2 `union` fv S `union` fv U ]
      G1 ⊢k S <⦂ U k⊣ G2 <->
    [ L `union` fv G1 `union` fv G2 `union` fv S `union` fv U ]
      G1 >> S <⦂ U << G2.

content.content:
=== /workspace/dsub/Definitions.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Export StdSetup.

Require Export VarDef.

Inductive typ : Set :=
| typ_top : typ
| typ_bot : typ
| typ_sel : avar -> typ
| typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ
| typ_bnd :  typ -> typ -> typ.

Inductive lc_avar_at : nat -> avar -> Prop :=
  | lc_ab : forall {n m}, n < m -> lc_avar_at m (avar_b n)
  | lc_af : forall {n x}, lc_avar_at n (avar_f x).

Global Instance LcAvar : LC avar := { lc_at := lc_avar_at }.

Inductive lc_typ_at : nat -> typ -> Prop :=
  | lc_typ_top : forall {n}, lc_typ_at n typ_top
  | lc_typ_bot : forall {n}, lc_typ_at n typ_bot
  | lc_typ_sel : forall {n v}, lc_at n v -> lc_typ_at n (typ_sel v)
  | lc_typ_all : forall {n T U}, lc_typ_at n T -> lc_typ_at (S n) U ->
                            lc_typ_at n (typ_all T U)
  | lc_typ_bnd : forall {n S U}, lc_typ_at n S -> lc_typ_at n U ->
                            lc_typ_at n (typ_bnd S U).

Global Instance LcTyp : LC typ := { lc_at := lc_typ_at }.

Definition open_rec_avar (k : nat) (u : var) (a : avar) : avar :=
    match a with
    | avar_b i => if k == i then avar_f u else avar_b i
    | avar_f x => avar_f x
    end.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k : nat) (u : var) (T : typ) : typ :=
    match T with
    | typ_top => typ_top
    | typ_bot => typ_bot
    | typ_sel x => typ_sel $ open_rec_avar k u x
    | typ_all T U => typ_all (open_rec_typ k u T) $ open_rec_typ (S k) u U
    | typ_bnd T U => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ k u T) $ open_rec_typ k u U
    end.

Global Instance OpenAvar : CanOpen avar := { open_rec := open_rec_avar }.

Global Instance OpenTyp : CanOpen typ := { open_rec := open_rec_typ }.

Notation env := (list (var * typ)).

Definition fv_avar (v : avar) : vars :=
    match v with
    | avar_b _ => {}
    | avar_f x => {{ x }}
    end.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T : typ) : vars :=
    match T with
    | typ_top | typ_bot => {}
    | typ_sel x => fv_avar x
    | typ_all T1 T2 | typ_bnd T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 \u fv_typ T2
    end.

Global Instance FvAvar : HasFv avar := { fv := fv_avar }.

Global Instance FvTyp : HasFv typ := { fv := fv_typ }.

Global Instance FvEnv : HasFv env := { fv := fun e => dom e `union` fv_values fv e }.
=== /workspace/dsub/VarDef.v ===
Require Import StdSetup.

Inductive avar : Set :=
| avar_b : nat -> avar
| avar_f : var -> avar.

Definition fv_values {T : Type} (f : T -> atoms)
           (l : list (atom * T)) : atoms :=
  fold_right (fun (b : (atom * T)) a =>
                a \u let (_, t) := b in f t) {} l.
=== /workspace/dsub/Misc.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Definitions.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=

| wf_nil : wf_env nil

| wf_cons : forall {x T G}, x \notin fv T \u fv G ->
                       fv T [<=] dom G ->
                       wf_env G ->
                       lc T ->
                       wf_env (x ~ T ++ G).

Definition is_sel (T : typ) :=
    match T with
    | typ_sel _ => True
    | _ => False
    end.
=== /workspace/dsub/Stareat.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Definitions.

Require Import Misc.

Reserved Notation "G1 ⊢ S ⤊ G2 ⊢! U" (at level 90).

Inductive revealing : env -> typ -> env -> typ -> Prop :=

| rv_stop : forall G T,
    ~is_sel T ->
    G ⊢ T ⤊ G ⊢! T

| rv_top : forall G T,
    G ⊢ T ⤊ nil ⊢! typ_top

| rv_bot : forall G1 G2 G1' T (x : var),
    G1 ⊢ T ⤊ G1' ⊢! typ_bot ->
    G2 ++ x ~ T ++ G1 ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) ⤊ nil ⊢! typ_bot

| rv_bnd : forall G1 G2 T G1' G1'' (x : var) L U U',
    G1 ⊢ T ⤊ G1' ⊢! typ_bnd L U ->
    G1' ⊢ U ⤊ G1'' ⊢! U' ->
    G2 ++ x ~ T ++ G1 ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) ⤊ G1'' ⊢! U'
where "G1 ⊢ S ⤊ G2 ⊢! U" := (revealing G1 S G2 U).

Reserved Notation "G1 ⊢ S ↗ G2 ⊢! U" (at level 90).

Inductive upcast : env -> avar -> env -> typ -> Prop :=

| uc_top : forall G x,
    G ⊢ x ↗ nil ⊢! typ_top

| uc_bot : forall G1 G2 x T G1',
    G1 ⊢ T ⤊ G1' ⊢! typ_bot ->
    G2 ++ x ~ T ++ G1 ⊢ avar_f x ↗ nil ⊢! typ_bot

| uc_bnd : forall G1 G2 x T G1' L U,
    G1 ⊢ T ⤊ G1' ⊢! typ_bnd L U ->
    G2 ++ x ~ T ++ G1 ⊢ avar_f x ↗ G1' ⊢! U
where "G1 ⊢ S ↗ G2 ⊢! U" := (upcast G1 S G2 U).

Reserved Notation "G1 ⊢ S ↘ G2 ⊢! U" (at level 90).

Inductive downcast : env -> avar -> env -> typ -> Prop :=

| dc_bot : forall G x,
    G ⊢ x ↘ nil ⊢! typ_bot

| dc_top : forall G1 G2 x T G1',
    G1 ⊢ T ⤊ G1' ⊢! typ_bot ->
    downcast (G2 ++ x ~ T ++ G1) (avar_f x) nil typ_top

| dc_bnd : forall G1 G2 x T G1' L U,
    revealing G1 T G1' (typ_bnd L U) ->
    downcast (G2 ++ x ~ T ++ G1) (avar_f x) G1' L
where "G1 ⊢ S ↘ G2 ⊢! U" := (downcast G1 S G2 U).

Reserved Notation "[ L ] G1 >> T '<⦂' U << G2" (at level 70).

Inductive stareat : atoms -> env -> typ -> typ -> env -> Prop :=

| sa_bot : forall L G1 T G2, [ L ] G1 >> typ_bot <⦂ T << G2

| sa_top : forall L G1 T G2, [ L ] G1 >> T <⦂ typ_top << G2

| sa_sel_refl : forall L G1 x G2, [ L ] G1 >> typ_sel x <⦂ typ_sel x << G2

| sa_sel_left : forall L G1 x G2 T U G1',
    G1 ⊢ x ↗ G1' ⊢! T ->
    [ L ] G1' >> T <⦂ U << G2 ->
    [ L ] G1 >> typ_sel x <⦂ U << G2

| sa_sel_right : forall L G1 x G2 T U G2',
    G2 ⊢ x ↘ G2' ⊢! U ->
    [ L ] G1 >> T <⦂ U << G2' ->
    [ L ] G1 >> T <⦂ typ_sel x << G2

| sa_all : forall L G1 T1 U1 G2 T2 U2 x,
    x `notin` fv G1 `union` fv T1 `union` fv T2
      `union` fv U1 `union` fv U2 `union` fv G2 `union` L ->
    [ L ] G2 >> T2 <⦂ T1 << G1 ->
    [ L  `union` singleton x `union` fv T2 ]
      x ~ T1 ++ G1 >> open x U1 <⦂ open x U2 << x ~ T2 ++ G2 ->
    [ L ] G1 >> typ_all T1 U1 <⦂ typ_all T2 U2 << G2

| sa_bnd : forall L G1 S1 U1 S2 U2 G2,
    [ L ] G2 >> S2 <⦂ S1 << G1 ->
    [ L ] G1 >> U1 <⦂ U2 << G2 ->

We need well-formedness of the environment: if T = declared type of y in env G, then fv Ty ⊆ dom G1 (where G1 is the suffix after y). That's a wf_env property. Also we may need lc preservation and maybe wf_env preservation for the theorem's induction. Let's gather.

Hmm wait, actually maybe we don't need full fv invariants if we formulate restricts differently: maybe we can require fv of *all involved types* and prove by induction with those. Let's define the restriction lemma for stareat to include the *wf_env* of the actual envs? and lc? Actually the theorem's hyps give wf_env G1 G2, lc S lc U, fv conditions. Require Import Definitions.
Require Import Stareat.
Require Import Misc.
Require Import Task.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Basic lemmas about fv and open                                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma fv_open_rec_upper : forall k u T,
    fv (open_rec_typ k u T) [<=] fv T \u {{u}}.
Proof.
  intros k u T. induction T; simpl; intros a Ha.
  - fsetdec.
  - fsetdec.
  - destruct a0; simpl in *.
    + destruct (k == n); simpl in *; fsetdec.
    + fsetdec.
  - fsetdec.
  - fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_upper : forall u T, fv (open_rec_typ 0 u T) [<=] fv T \u {{u}}.
Proof.
  intros. apply fv_open_rec_upper.
Qed.

(* membership-wise version, more convenient *)
Lemma fv_open_rec_in : forall k u T y,
    y `in` fv (open_rec_typ k u T) -> y `in` fv T \/ y = u.
Proof.
  intros k u T y H. pose proof (fv_open_rec_upper k u T). unfold subset in H0.
  pose proof (H0 y H) as H1. clear H0. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_rec_self : forall k u T,
    u `notin` fv T -> fv (open_rec_typ k u T) [<=] fv T.
Proof.
  intros k u T H. pose proof (fv_open_rec_upper k u T). intros a Ha.
  apply fv_open_rec_in in Ha. destruct Ha; [ assumption | subst; fsetdec ].
Qed.

Lemma lc_at_mono : forall T n m, lc_at n T -> n <= m -> lc_at m T.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T; intros n m H Hle; simpl in *; auto using lc_typ_top, lc_typ_bot.
  - inversion H; constructor. inversion H0; simpl in *. omega.
  - inversion H; subst. apply lc_typ_all.
    + apply IHT1 with (n0 := n); auto.
    + apply IHT2 with (n0 := S n); auto. omega.
  - inversion H; subst. apply lc_typ_bnd; auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_typ_open_rec : forall k u T,
    lc_at (S k) T -> lc_at k (open_rec_typ k u T).
Proof.
  intros k u T. revert k. induction T; simpl; intros k H.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - destruct a0; simpl.
    + destruct (k == n) eqn:E.
      * constructor.
      * constructor. inversion H. simpl in *. apply Nat.eqb_neq in E. omega.
    + constructor.
  - inversion H; subst. apply lc_typ_all.
    + apply IHT1 with (k := k). assumption.
    + apply IHT2 with (k := S k). assumption.
  - inversion H; subst. apply lc_typ_bnd; auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_open : forall u T, lc_at 1 T -> lc (open_rec_typ 0 u T).
Proof.
  intros u T H. unfold lc. change (lc_at 0 (open_rec_typ 0 u T)).
  apply lc_typ_open_rec. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma lc_at_top : forall n, lc_at n typ_top. constructor. Qed.
Lemma lc_at_bot : forall n, lc_at n typ_bot. constructor. Qed.

Lemma lc_bnd_inv : forall n T1 T2, lc_at n (typ_bnd T1 T2) ->
                                 lc_at n T1 /\ lc_at n T2.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.

Lemma lc_all_inv : forall n T1 T2, lc_at n (typ_all T1 T2) ->
                                 lc_at n T1 /\ lc_at (S n) T2.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.

Lemma fv_bnd_inv : forall T1 T2, fv (typ_bnd T1 T2) [=] fv T1 \u fv T2.
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fv_all_inv : forall T1 T2, fv (typ_all T1 T2) [=] fv T1 \u fv U2 -> True.
Proof. intros. exact I. Qed.

Lemma fv_bnd_subset_l : forall T1 T2, fv T1 [<=] fv (typ_bnd T1 T2).
Proof. intros. simpl. fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma fv_bnd_subset_r : forall T1 T2, fv T2 [<=] fv (typ_bnd T1 T2).
Proof. intros. simpl. fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma fv_all_subset_l : forall T1 T2, fv T1 [<=] fv (typ_all T1 T2).
Proof. intros. simpl. fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma fv_all_subset_r : forall T1 T2, fv T2 [<=] fv (typ_all T1 T2).
Proof. intros. simpl. fsetdec. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Environment lemmas                                                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma wf_env_suffix : forall A G, wf_env (A ++ G) -> wf_env G.
Proof.
  intros A. induction A as [| [y Ty] A IH]; simpl; intros G H.
  - assumption.
  - apply IHA in H. inversion H. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_binds_notin_fv : forall G x T,
    wf_env G -> binds x T G -> x `notin` fv T.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [| [y Ty] G IH]; intros x T Hwf Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - simpl in Hwf. inversion Hwf; subst.
    destruct (binds_cons_iff _ _ _ _) as [_ Hiff]. (* just use inversion on binds *)
    apply binds_cons_1 in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heq HTeq] | Hb].
    + subst. fsetdec.
    + assert (x <> y) as Hne by (intro; subst; firstorder).
      assert (x `notin` fv G) by (apply IH; auto).
      assert (y `notin` fv G) as Hy by fsetdec.
      (* x notin fv ((y,Ty)::G) *)
      simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_binds_lc : forall G x T,
    wf_env G -> binds x T G -> lc T.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [| [y Ty] G IH]; intros x T Hwf Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - inversion Hwf; subst.
    apply binds_cons_1 in Hb. destruct Hb as [[Heq HTeq] | Hb].
    + subst. assumption.
    + apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_binds_fv_dom : forall G x T,
    wf_env G -> binds x T G -> fv T [<=] dom G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [| [y Ty] G IH]; intros x T Hwf Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - inversion Hwf; subst.
    apply binds_cons_1 in Hb. destruct Hb as [[Heq HTeq] | Hb].
    + subst. simpl. apply subset_trans with (s2 := dom G); auto. fsetdec.
    + apply subset_trans with (s2 := dom G); auto. simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

(* Uniqueness of decomposition for a bound variable *)
Lemma binds_decomp_uniq : forall G x T1 T2 A1 B1 A2 B2,
    uniq G ->
    G = A1 ++ x ~ T1 ++ B1 ->
    G = A2 ++ x ~ T2 ++ B2 ->
    T1 = T2 /\ B1 = B2.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [| [y Ty] G IH]; intros x T1 T2 A1 B1 A2 B2 Huniq E1 E2.
  - destruct A1; destruct A2; simpl in *; try discriminate.
    + inversion E1; inversion E2; subst. auto.
    + inversion E1.

(* membership-wise version, more convenient *)
Lemma fv_open_rec_in : forall k u T y,
    y `in` fv (open_rec_typ k u T) -> y `in` fv T \/ y = u.

  intros k u T y H. pose proof (fv_open_rec_upper k u T). unfold subset in H0.

Lemma fv_open_rec_self : forall k u T,
    u `notin` fv T -> fv (open_rec_typ k u T) [<=] fv T.
Proof.

Qed.

Lemma lc_at_mono : forall T n m, lc_at n T -> n <= m -> lc_at m T.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T; intros n m H Hle; simpl in *; auto using lc_typ_top, lc_typ_bot.

    + apply IHT2 with (n0 := S n); auto. omega.
  - inversion H; subst. apply lc_typ_bnd; auto.
Qed.

  - constructor.
  - destruct a0; simpl.

    + constructor.
  - inversion H; subst. apply lc_typ_all.
    + apply IHT1 with (k := k). assumption.
    + apply IHT2 with (k := S k). assumption.
  - inversion H; subst. apply lc_typ_bnd; auto.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Environment filtering                                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition filter_env (X:atoms) (G:env) : env :=
  filter (fun p => AtomSetImpl.mem (fst p) X) G.

Lemma mem_iff' : forall (x:atom) (X:atoms), x `in` X <-> AtomSetImpl.mem x X = true.
Proof. intros. apply mem_iff. Qed.

Lemma filter_env_app : forall X A B,
    filter_env X (A ++ B) = filter_env X A ++ filter_env X B.
Proof. intros. unfold filter_env. apply filter_app. Qed.

Lemma filter_env_in : forall X G p,
    In p (filter_env X G) <-> In p G /\ AtomSetImpl.mem (fst p) X = true.
Proof. intros. unfold filter_env. apply filter_In. Qed.

Lemma filter_env_binds_iff : forall X G x T,
    binds x T (filter_env X G) <-> x `in` X /\ binds x T G.
Proof.
  intros X G. induction G as [| [y Ty] G IH]; intros x T. 
  - simpl. split; intros H; [ inversion H | destruct H as [Hx Hb]; inversion Hb ].
  - simpl. unfold filter_env. simpl.
    destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem y X) eqn:E.
    + simpl. rewrite binds_cons_iff. rewrite IH. rewrite mem_iff in E.
      (* goal: (x=y /\ T=Ty \/ (x in X /\ binds x T G)) <-> x in X /\ (x=y /\ T=Ty \/ binds x T G) *)
      split.
      * intros [(Heq & HTeq) | (Hx & Hb)].
        -- subst. split; [ assumption | left; auto ].
        -- split; [ assumption | right; assumption ].
      * intros [Hx [(Heq & HTeq) | Hb]].
        -- subst. left; auto.
        -- right; auto.
    + simpl. rewrite mem_iff in E. rewrite IH.
      split.
      * intros (Hx & Hb). split; [ assumption | right; assumption ].
      * intros [Hx [(Heq & HTeq) | Hb]].
        -- subst. exfalso. apply E. assumption.
        -- split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma filter_env_binds_1 : forall X G x T,
    binds x T (filter_env X G) -> x `in` X /\ binds x T G.
Proof. intros. apply filter_env_binds_iff; auto. Qed.

Lemma filter_env_binds_2 : forall X G x T,
    x `in` X -> binds x T G -> binds x T (filter_env X G).
Proof. intros. apply filter_env_binds_iff; auto. Qed.

Lemma filter_env_dom_sub : forall X G, dom (filter_env X G) [<=] dom G.
Proof.
  intros X G. induction G as [| [y Ty] G IH]; simpl.
  - fsetdec.
  - unfold filter_env in *. simpl.
    destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem y X); simpl; fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma filter_env_fv_sub : forall X G, fv (filter_env X G) [<=] fv G.
Proof.
  intros X G. induction G as [| [y Ty] G IH]; simpl.
  - fsetdec.
  - unfold filter_env in *. simpl.
    destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem y X); simpl; fsetdec.
Qed.

Definition closed_env (X:atoms) (G:env) : Prop :=
  forall y Ty, y `in` X -> binds y Ty G -> fv Ty [<=] X.

Lemma closed_env_sub : forall X A B, closed_env X (A ++ B) -> closed_env X B.
Proof.
  intros X A B H y Ty Hy Hb. apply H; auto.
  apply binds_app_3; auto.
Qed.

Lemma closed_env_filter : forall X G, closed_env X G -> closed_env X (filter_env X G).
Proof.
  intros X G H y Ty Hy Hb. apply filter_env_binds_1 in Hb.
  destruct Hb as [Hx Hb]. apply H; auto.
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_filter : forall X G y,
    y `in` dom G -> y `in` X -> y `in` dom (filter_env X G).
Proof.
  intros X G y Hd Hx. apply binds_In_inv in Hd. destruct Hd as [Ty Hb].
  apply binds_In with (a := Ty). apply filter_env_binds_2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma filter_env_wf : forall X G,
    wf_env G -> closed_env X G -> wf_env (filter_env X G).
Proof.
  intros X G Hwf. induction Hwf as [| x T G Hx Hsub HwfG IH]; intro Hcl.
  - simpl. unfold filter_env. simpl. apply wf_nil.
  - simpl. unfold filter_env. simpl.
    destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem x X) eqn:E.
    + apply mem_iff in E.
      apply wf_cons.
      * simpl. rewrite filter_env_fv_sub. fsetdec. 
        (* x notin fv T u fv (filter X G) *)
        assert (x `notin` fv G) by fsetdec.
        rewrite <- filter_env_fv_sub. fsetdec.
      * (* fv T [<=] dom (filter X G) *)
        intros y Hy. apply in_dom_filter.
        -- apply Hsub; assumption.
        -- assert (fv T [<=] X).
           { apply Hcl with (y := x) (Ty := T); auto. }
           fsetdec.
      * apply IH. apply closed_env_sub with (A := x ~ T). exact Hcl.
      * assumption.
    + (* x notin X: filter drops head *)
      apply mem_iff in E.
      apply IH. apply closed_env_sub with (A := x ~ T). exact Hcl.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Conversions between subtysk and the size-indexed subtysk'    *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma subtysk'_subtysk : forall (n:nat) L (G1:env) S U (G2:env),
    subtysk' L G1 S U G2 n -> subtysk L G1 S U G2.
Proof.
  intros n L G1 S U G2 H. induction H.
  - apply ssk_refl.
  - apply ssk_top.
  - apply ssk_bot.
  - eapply ssk_bnd; eauto.
  - eapply ssk_all; eauto.
  - eapply ssk_sel1; eauto.
  - eapply ssk_sel2; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma subtysk_subtysk' : forall L (G1:env) S U (G2:env),
    subtysk L G1 S U G2 -> exists n, subtysk' L G1 S U G2 n.
Proof.
  intros L G1 S U G2 H. induction H.
  - exists 1. apply ssk'_refl.
  - exists 1. apply ssk'_top.
  - exists 1. apply ssk'_bot.
  - destruct IHH1 as [n1 H1]. destruct IHH2 as [n2 H2].
    exists (1 + n1 + n2). eapply ssk'_bnd; eauto.
  - destruct IHH1 as [n1 H1]. destruct IHH2 as [n2 H2].
    exists (1 + n1 + n2). eapply ssk'_all; eauto.
  - destruct IHH as [n Hn]. exists (1 + n). eapply ssk'_sel1; eauto.
  - destruct IHH as [n Hn]. exists (1 + n). eapply ssk'_sel2; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma bot_elim : forall L (G1:env) (G2:env) S,
    [ L ] G1 ⊢k S <⦂ typ_bot k⊣ G2 ->
    forall U (G3:env), [ L ] G1 ⊢k S <⦂ U k⊣ G3.
Proof.
  intros L G1 G2 S D.
  destruct (subtysk_subtysk' D) as [n Hn].
  intros U G3.
  destruct (proj1 (bot_pair n) L G1 G2 S Hn U G3) as [m Hm].
  apply subtysk'_subtysk in Hm. exact Hm.
Qed.

Lemma bnd_bot_cov : forall L (Gx:env) S (Gy:env) X,
    [ L ] Gx ⊢k S <⦂ typ_bnd typ_bot X k⊣ Gy ->
    forall Y, bot_to X Y ->
      forall Gz, [ L ] Gx ⊢k S <⦂ typ_bnd typ_bot Y k⊣ Gz.
Proof.

  destruct (subtysk_subtysk' D) as [n Hn].
  destruct (proj2 (bot_pair n) L Gx S Gy X Hn Y Hbt Gz) as [m Hm].

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Boundary elimination for the strong kernel relation.         *)
(* Proved jointly on the size-indexed relation subtysk' by      *)
(* well-founded induction:                                      *)
(*   A. S <: bot  =>  S <: U                                    *)
(*   B. S <: bnd bot X, X ->step Y  =>  S <: bnd bot Y          *)
(*   C. S <: bnd top top  =>  S <: bnd B top                    *)
(*   D. top <: U  =>  B <: U                                    *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Inductive bot_to : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| bt_bot : forall U, bot_to typ_bot U
| bt_top : forall X, bot_to X typ_top
| bt_bnd : forall X Y, bot_to X Y -> bot_to (typ_bnd typ_bot X) (typ_bnd typ_bot Y)
| bt_low : forall B, bot_to (typ_bnd typ_top typ_top) (typ_bnd B typ_top).

Lemma bot_quad : forall (n:nat),
  (forall L (G1 G2:env) S, subtysk' L G1 S typ_bot G2 n ->
     forall U G3, exists m, subtysk' L G1 S U G3 m)
  /\
  (forall L (Gx:env) S (Gy:env) X, subtysk' L Gx S (typ_bnd typ_bot X) Gy n ->
     forall Y, bot_to X Y -> forall Gz, exists m, subtysk' L Gx S (typ_bnd typ_bot Y) Gz m)
  /\
  (forall L (Gx:env) S (Gy:env), subtysk' L Gx S (typ_bnd typ_top typ_top) Gy n ->
     forall B Gz, exists m, subtysk' L Gx S (typ_bnd B typ_top) Gz m)
  /\
  (forall L (Gx:env) (Gy:env) U, subtysk' L Gx typ_top U Gy n ->
     forall B Gz, exists m, subtysk' L Gz B U Gy m).
Proof.
  intros n. induction n using lt_wf_ind. rename H into IHn.
  repeat split.
  - (* A : bottom elimination *)
    intros L G1 G2 S Hely U G3.
    inversion Hely; subst.
    + exists 1. apply ssk'_bot.
    + destruct (IHn n0 ltac:(lia)) as [IHA [IHB [IHC IHD]]].
      destruct (IHB L G1 T G2 typ_bot H0 U (bt_bot U) G3) as [m Hm].
      exists (S m). apply ssk'_sel2 with (x := x) (T := T); auto.
  - (* B : bottom covariance *)
    intros L Gx S Gy X Hely Y Hbt Gz.
    inversion Hely; subst.
    + exists 1. apply ssk'_bot.
    + destruct (IHn n2 ltac:(lia)) as [IHA [IHB [IHC IHD]]].
      assert (H7' : exists m2, subtysk' L Gx T2 Y Gz m2).
      { destruct Hbt as [U0 | X0b | X0b Y0 Hbt0 | B0].
        - destruct (IHA L Gx Gy T2 H7 U0 Gz) as [m2 Hm2]. exists m2. exact Hm2.
        - exists 1. apply ssk'_top.
        - destruct (IHB L Gx T2 Gy X0b H7 Y0 Hbt0 Gz) as [m2 Hm2].
          exists m2. exact Hm2.
        - destruct (IHC L Gx T2 Gy H7 B0 Gz) as [m2 Hm2]. exists m2. exact Hm2. }
      destruct H7' as [m2 Hm2].
      exists (1 + 1 + m2). eapply ssk'_bnd; [ apply ssk'_bot | exact Hm2 ].
    + destruct (IHn n0 ltac:(lia)) as [IHA [IHB [IHC IHD]]].
      destruct (IHB L Gx T Gy (typ_bnd typ_bot X) H0
                  (typ_bnd typ_bot Y) (bt_bnd Hbt) Gz) as [m Hm].
      exists (S m). apply ssk'_sel2 with (x := x) (T := T); auto.
  - (* C : top-lower covariance *)
    intros L Gx S Gy Hely B Gz.
    inversion Hely; subst.
    + exists 1. apply ssk'_bot.
    + destruct (IHn n1 ltac:(lia)) as [IHA [IHB [IHC IHD]]].
      destruct (IHD L Gy Gx T1 H4 B Gz) as [m1 Hm1].
      exists (1 + m1 + 1). eapply ssk'_bnd; [ exact Hm1 | apply ssk'_top ].
    + destruct (IHn n0 ltac:(lia)) as [IHA [IHB [IHC IHD]]].
      destruct (IHB L Gx T Gy (typ_bnd typ_top typ_top) H0
                  (typ_bnd B typ_top) (bt_low B) Gz) as [m Hm].
      exists (S m). apply ssk'_sel2 with (x := x) (T := T); auto.
  - (* D : top elimination *)
    intros L Gx Gy U Hely B Gz.
    inversion Hely; subst.
    + exists 1. apply ssk'_top.
    + destruct (IHn n0 ltac:(lia)) as [IHA [IHB [IHC IHD]]].
      destruct (IHC L Gy T Gx H0 B Gz) as [m Hm].
      exists (S m). apply ssk'_sel1 with (x := x) (T := T); auto.
Qed.

  intros G x G' T Hup.
  induction Hup as [G0 x0 | G1 G2 x0 T0 G1' Hrev | G1 G2 x0 T0 G1' Lb V0 Hrev];

    assert (HR : [ L ] (G2 ++ x0 ~ T0) ++ G1 ⊢k T0 <⦂ typ_bot k⊣ G1').

Inductive avar : Set :=
| avar_b : nat -> avar
| avar_f : var -> avar.

Definition fv_values {T : Type} (f : T -> atoms)
           (l : list (atom * T)) : atoms :=
  fold_right (fun (b : (atom * T)) a =>
                a \u let (_, t) := b in f t) {} l.
    | typ_bot => typ_bot
    | typ_sel x => typ_sel $ open_rec_avar k u x
    | typ_all T U => typ_all (open_rec_typ k u T) $ open_rec_typ (S k) u U
    | typ_bnd T U => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ k u T) $ open_rec_typ k u U
    end.

Global Instance OpenAvar : CanOpen avar := { open_rec := open_rec_avar }.

    match v with
    | avar_b _ => {}
    | avar_f x => {{ x }}
    end.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T : typ) : vars :=
    match T with
    | typ_top | typ_bot => {}
    | typ_sel x => fv_avar x
    | typ_all T1 T2 | typ_bnd T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 \u fv_typ T2
    end.

Global Instance FvAvar : HasFv avar := { fv := fv_avar }.

Global Instance FvTyp : HasFv typ := { fv := fv_typ }.

Global Instance FvEnv : HasFv env := { fv := fun e => dom e `union` fv_values fv e }.

Lemma revealing_fv : forall G T G' U,
    wf_env G -> fv T [<=] dom G -> revealing G T G' U -> fv U [<=] dom G'.
Proof.
  intros G T G' U Hwf Hfv H.
  induction H as [G0 T0 Hns | G0 T0 | G1 G2 G1' T0 x H1 IH1
                  | G1 G2 T0 G1' G1'' x Lb V U' H1 IH1 H2 IH2].
  - exact Hfv.
  - simpl. fsetdec.
  - simpl. fsetdec.
  - assert (HwfX : wf_env (x ~ T0 ++ G1)).
    { apply wf_env_suffix with (A := G2). exact Hwf. }
    destruct (wf_env_cons_inv HwfX) as [_ [HfvT [Hwf1 HlcT]]].
    assert (HfvB : fv (typ_bnd Lb V) [<=] dom G1') by (apply IH1; assumption).
    assert (HfvV : fv V [<=] dom G1').
    { apply Subset_trans with (s' := fv (typ_bnd Lb V)).
      - apply fv_bnd_subset_r.
      - exact HfvB. }
    apply IH2.
    + exact (revealing_wf Hwf1 H1).
    + exact HfvV.
Qed.

Lemma revealing_lc : forall G T G' U,
    wf_env G -> lc T -> revealing G T G' U -> lc U.
Proof.

  induction H as [G0 T0 Hns | G0 T0 | G1 G2 G1' T0 x H1 IH1
                  | G1 G2 T0 G1' G1'' x Lb V U' H1 IH1 H2 IH2].
  - exact Hlc.
  - apply lc_typ_top.
  - apply lc_typ_bot.

    destruct (wf_env_cons_inv HwfX) as [_ [_ [Hwf1 HlcT]]].
    assert (HlcB : lc (typ_bnd Lb V)) by (apply IH1; assumption).
    destruct (lc_bnd_inv HlcB) as [HLb HV].
    apply IH2.
    + exact (revealing_wf Hwf1 H1).

The result env is the suffix below the selector's binding; if the env is reordered, the "suffix below" differs. We don't reorder, only delete, so order is preserved. env_sub as In-inclusion plus the guarantee that deletions preserve uniqueness might be enough if we can split consistently. Without order info, we can't establish that the entries of G0suf are entries of G1 (they're entries of G, but could be entries from above x or the x binding? G0's entries after x's position in G0 are subset of G's entries after x's position in G? This uses order preservation: if G0 is a sublist of G (order preserving), then the entries after the matched x binding in G0 are a sublist of the entries after the matched x binding in G. This is a standard sublist property. So ordered sublist is the right relation.

Lemma wf_env_binds_split : forall (G:env) x T,
    wf_env G -> binds x T G ->
    exists A B, G = A ++ x ~ T ++ B /\ fv T [<=] dom B /\ lc T.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [| [y Ty] G IH]; intros x T Hwf Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - inversion Hwf; subst.
    apply binds_cons_1 in Hb. destruct Hb as [[Heq HTeq] | Hb].
    + subst. exists nil, G. simpl. split; [ reflexivity | split; assumption ].
    + destruct (IH x T H4 Hb) as [A [B [Heq [Hfv Hlc]]]].
      exists ((y,Ty)::A), B. simpl. rewrite Heq. split; [ reflexivity | split; assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma binds_mid_self : forall (A B:env) (x:atom) (T:typ),
    binds x T (A ++ x ~ T ++ B).
Proof. intros. apply binds_app_3. apply binds_app_2. apply binds_one_3; auto. Qed.

Lemma app_decomp_uniq : forall (A:env) (B:env) (x:atom) (T:typ),
    uniq (A ++ x ~ T ++ B) ->
    forall A' B', A ++ x ~ T ++ B = A' ++ x ~ T ++ B' -> A = A' /\ B = B'.
Proof.
  intros A. induction A as [| [y U] A IH]; intros B x T Huniq A' B' Heq.
  - destruct A' as [| [z V] A'].
    + simpl in *. inversion Heq; subst. auto.
    + simpl in *.
      injection Heq as Hxz HTV HB.
      assert (Hin : x `in` dom B).
      { apply binds_In with (a := T). rewrite HB. apply binds_mid_self. }
      exfalso. apply uniq_cons_2 in Huniq. fsetdec.
  - destruct A' as [| [z V] A'].
    + simpl in *.
      injection Heq as Hyx HU HB.
      assert (Hin : x `in` dom (A ++ (x,T)::B)).
      { apply binds_In with (a := T). apply binds_mid_self. }
      exfalso. subst y. subst U. apply uniq_cons_2 in Huniq. fsetdec.
    + simpl in *. injection Heq as Hy HU Htail. subst.
      assert (A = A' /\ B = B').
      { apply IH with (B := B) (x := x) (T := T); auto.
        apply uniq_cons_1 in Huniq. exact Huniq. }
      destruct H; subst. auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_decomp_uniq : forall (G:env) x T1 T2 A1 B1 A2 B2,
    uniq G ->
    G = A1 ++ x ~ T1 ++ B1 ->
    G = A2 ++ x ~ T2 ++ B2 ->
    T1 = T2 /\ B1 = B2.
Proof.
  intros G x T1 T2 A1 B1 A2 B2 Huniq E1 E2.
  assert (Hb1 : binds x T1 G) by (rewrite E1; apply binds_mid_self).
  assert (Hb2 : binds x T2 G) by (rewrite E2; apply binds_mid_self).
  assert (Heq : T1 = T2).
  { apply binds_unique with (x := x) (a := T1) (b := T2) (E := G); auto. }
  subst T2.
  assert (AB : A1 = A2 /\ B1 = B2).
  { apply (app_decomp_uniq A1 B1 x T1).
    - rewrite <- E1. exact Huniq.
    - rewrite <- E1. rewrite E2. reflexivity. }
  tauto.
Qed.

Require Import Arith Wf_nat.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Size-indexed revealing (for well-founded induction)          *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Inductive revealing_sz : nat -> env -> typ -> env -> typ -> Prop :=
| rsz_stop : forall G T, ~is_sel T -> revealing_sz 1 G T G T
| rsz_top : forall G T, revealing_sz 1 G T nil typ_top
| rsz_bot : forall G1 G2 G1' T x n,
    revealing_sz n G1 T G1' typ_bot ->
    revealing_sz (S n) (G2 ++ x ~ T ++ G1) (typ_sel (avar_f x)) nil typ_bot
| rsz_bnd : forall G1 G2 T G1' G1'' x L U U' n1 n2,
    revealing_sz n1 G1 T G1' (typ_bnd L U) ->
    revealing_sz n2 G1' U G1'' U' ->
    revealing_sz (S (n1 + n2)) (G2 ++ x ~ T ++ G1) (typ_sel (avar_f x)) G1'' U'.

Lemma revealing_sz_revealing : forall n G T G' U,
    revealing_sz n G T G' U -> revealing G T G' U.
Proof.
  intros n G T G' U H.
  induction H as [G0 T0 Hns | G0 T0 | G1 G2 G1' T0 x m Hm IHm
                  | G1 G2 T0 G1' G1'' x Lb V U' n1 n2 Hm1 IHm1 Hm2 IHm2].
  - apply rv_stop; auto.
  - apply rv_top.
  - eapply rv_bot with (G1' := G1'); eauto.
  - eapply rv_bnd with (G1' := G1'); eauto.
Qed.

Lemma revealing_revealing_sz : forall G T G' U,
    revealing G T G' U -> exists n, revealing_sz n G T G' U.
Proof.
  intros G T G' U H.
  induction H as [G0 T0 Hns | G0 T0 | G1 G2 G1' T0 x H1 IH1
                  | G1 G2 T0 G1' G1'' x Lb V U' H1 IH1 H2 IH2].
  - exists 1. apply rsz_stop; auto.
  - exists 1. apply rsz_top.
  - destruct IH1 as [n Hn]. exists (S n). eapply rsz_bot with (G1' := G1'); eauto.
  - destruct IH1 as [n1 Hn1]. destruct IH2 as [n2 Hn2].
    exists (S (n1 + n2)). eapply rsz_bnd; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma mem_false : forall (X:atoms) x, x `notin` X -> AtomSetImpl.mem x X = false.
Proof.
  intros X x H. destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem x X) eqn:E; auto. exfalso.
  apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2. exact E.
Qed.

Lemma env_filter_notin_all : forall X (G:env),
    (forall y, y `in` dom G -> y `notin` X) -> env_filter X G = nil.
Proof.
  intros X G H. unfold env_filter.
  induction G as [| [y U] G IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - assert (Hy : y `notin` X) by (apply H; simpl; fsetdec).
    rewrite (mem_false Hy). simpl.
    apply IH. intros z Hz. apply H. simpl; fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma env_filter_suffix : forall (A:env) (x:atom) (T:typ) (B:env),
    wf_env (A ++ x ~ T ++ B) -> env_filter (dom B) (A ++ x ~ T ++ B) = B.
Proof.
  intros A x T B W.
  assert (Huniq : uniq (A ++ x ~ T ++ B)) by (apply wf_env_uniq; exact W).
  assert (HxB : x `notin` dom B).
